shloka_text: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य रामे धर्मपरे स्थिते । कालस्तापसरूपेण राजद्वारमुपागमत् ।। 7.103.1 ।।
transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya rāme dharmapare sthite | kālastāpasarūpeṇa rājadvāramupāgamat || 7.103.1 ||
translation: कस्यचित् of some, तु indeed, अथ then, कालस्य of time, रामे while Rama, धर्मपरे devoted to righteousness, स्थिते was abiding, कालः Time, तापसरूपेण in the form of an ascetic, राजद्वारम् to the royal gate, उपागमत् approached.
explanation: Then, after some time, while Rama was abiding devoted to righteousness, Time, in the form of an ascetic, approached the royal gate.
comments: Time himself, in the guise of an ascetic and bearing a message from a great sage, comes to Rama's gate and asks a secret audience on condition that whoever sees or hears it be put to death -- Rama consents, posts Lakshmana at the door under that very charge, and bids the messenger speak.

shloka_text: सो ऽब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं धृतिमन्तं यशश्विनम् । मां निवेदय रामाय सम्प्राप्तं कार्यगौरवात् ।। 7.103.2 ।।
transliteration: so 'bravīllakṣmaṇaṃ vākyaṃ dhṛtimantaṃ yaśaśvinam | māṃ nivedaya rāmāya samprāptaṃ kāryagauravāt || 7.103.2 ||
translation: सः he, अब्रवीत् spoke, लक्ष्मणं to Lakshmana, वाक्यं words, धृतिमन्तं resolute, यशश्विनम् glorious, मां me, निवेदय announce, रामाय to Rama, सम्प्राप्तं arrived, कार्यगौरवात् due to the importance of the matter.
explanation: He spoke to the resolute and glorious Lakshmana, saying, "Announce my arrival to Rama, as I have come due to the grave importance of my mission."

shloka_text: दूतो ऽस्म्यतिबलस्याहं महर्षेरमितौजसः । रामं दिदृक्षुरायातः कार्येण हि महाबल ।। 7.103.3 ।।
transliteration: dūto 'smyatibalasyāhaṃ maharṣeramitaujasaḥ | rāmaṃ didṛkṣurāyātaḥ kāryeṇa hi mahābala || 7.103.3 ||
translation: दूतः a messenger, अस्मि I am, अतिबलस्य of the very powerful, अहं I, महर्षेः of the great sage, अमितौजसः of immeasurable energy, रामं Rama, दिदृक्षुः desirous of seeing, आयातः arrived, कार्येण for a purpose, हि indeed, महाबल O mighty one.
explanation: "O mighty one, I am indeed a messenger of a very powerful great sage of immeasurable energy, and I have arrived desirous of seeing Rama for an important purpose."

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सौमित्रिस्त्वरया ऽन्वितः । न्यवेदयत रामाय तापसं तं समागतम् ।। 7.103.4 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā saumitristvarayā 'nvitaḥ | nyavedayata rāmāya tāpasaṃ taṃ samāgatam || 7.103.4 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, त्वरया with haste, अन्वितः endowed, न्यवेदयत informed, रामाय to Rama, तापसं the ascetic, तं him, समागतम् arrived.
explanation: Having heard his words, Lakshmana, filled with haste, informed Rama about the arrival of that ascetic.

shloka_text: जयस्व राम धर्मेण उभौ लोकौ महाद्युते । दूतस्त्वां द्रष्टुमायातस्तपसा भास्करप्रभः ।। 7.103.5 ।।
transliteration: jayasva rāma dharmeṇa ubhau lokau mahādyute | dūtastvāṃ draṣṭumāyātastapasā bhāskaraprabhaḥ || 7.103.5 ||
translation: जयस्व conquer, राम O Rama, धर्मेण by righteousness, उभौ both, लोकौ worlds, महाद्युते O greatly radiant one, दूतः a messenger, त्वां you, द्रष्टुम् to see, आगतः has come, तपसा by penance, भास्करप्रभः radiant like the sun.
explanation: O greatly radiant Rama, conquer both worlds through righteousness; a messenger, radiant like the sun due to his penance, has arrived to see you.

shloka_text: तद्वाक्यं लक्ष्मणेनोक्तं श्रुत्वा राम उवाच ह । प्रवेश्यतां मुनिस्तात महौजास्तस्य वाक्यधृत् ।। 7.103.6 ।।
transliteration: tadvākyaṃ lakṣmaṇenoktaṃ śrutvā rāma uvāca ha | praveśyatāṃ munistāta mahaujāstasya vākyadhṛt || 7.103.6 ||
translation: तत् that, वाक्यं word, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, उक्तं spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, उवाच said, ह indeed, प्रवेश्यतां let him be admitted, मुनिः the sage, तात O dear one, महौजाः greatly powerful, तस्य his, वाक्यधृत् bearer of a message.
explanation: Having heard those words spoken by Lakshmana, Rama indeed said, "O dear one, let that greatly powerful sage, who is a bearer of a message, be admitted."

shloka_text: सौमित्रिस्तु तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रावेशयत तं मुनिम् । ज्वलन्तमेव तेजोभिः प्रदहन्तमिवांशुभिः ।। 7.103.7 ।।
transliteration: saumitristu tathetyuktvā prāveśayata taṃ munim | jvalantameva tejobhiḥ pradahantamivāṃśubhiḥ || 7.103.7 ||
translation: सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, तु and, तथा so be it, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, प्रावेशयत led in, तं that, मुनिम् sage, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, एव indeed, तेजोभिः with splendors, प्रदहन्तम् burning, इव as if, अंशुभिः with rays.
explanation: And Lakshmana, having said "So be it," led in that sage who was blazing with his own splendor, as if burning with rays of light.

shloka_text: सो ऽभिगम्य रघुश्रेष्ठं दीप्यपानं स्वतेजसा । ऋषिर्मधुरया वाचा वर्धस्वेत्याह राघवम् ।। 7.103.8 ।।
transliteration: so 'bhigamya raghuśreṣṭhaṃ dīpyapānaṃ svatejasā | ṛṣirmadhurayā vācā vardhasvetyāha rāghavam || 7.103.8 ||
translation: सः he, अभिगम्य having approached, रघुश्रेष्ठं the best of the Raghus, दीप्यमानं shining, स्वतेजसा with his own splendor, ऋषिः the sage, मधुरया with sweet, वाचा voice, वर्धस्व may you prosper, इति thus, आह said, राघवम् to Rama.
explanation: Having approached Rama, the best of the Raghus, who was shining with his own splendor, the sage said to him with a sweet voice, "May you prosper."

shloka_text: तस्मै रामो महातेजाः पूजामर्घ्यपुरोगमाम् । ददौ कुशलमव्यग्रं प्रष्टुमेवोपचक्रमे ।। 7.103.9 ।।
transliteration: tasmai rāmo mahātejāḥ pūjāmarghyapurogamām | dadau kuśalamavyagraṃ praṣṭumevopacakrame || 7.103.9 ||
translation: तस्मै to him, रामः Rama, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, पूजाम् honor, अर्घ्यपुरोगमाम् preceded by arghya, ददौ gave, कुशलम् welfare, अव्यग्रम् calmly, प्रष्टुम् to ask, एव indeed, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: The greatly effulgent Rama offered him honor, preceded by arghya, and calmly began to inquire about his well-being.

shloka_text: पृष्टश्च कुशलं तेन रामेण वदतां वरः । आसने काञ्चने दिव्ये निषसाद महायशाः ।। 7.103.10 ।।
transliteration: pṛṣṭaśca kuśalaṃ tena rāmeṇa vadatāṃ varaḥ | āsane kāñcane divye niṣasāda mahāyaśāḥ || 7.103.10 ||
translation: पृष्टः asked, च and, कुशलम् welfare, तेन by him, रामेण by Rama, वदतां वरः the best among speakers, आसने on the seat, काञ्चने golden, दिव्ये divine, निषसाद sat down, महायशाः the greatly renowned one.
explanation: And being asked about his welfare by Rama, the greatly renowned one, who was the best among speakers, sat down on a divine golden seat.

shloka_text: तमुवाच ततो रामः स्वागतं ते महामुने । प्रापयास्य च वाक्यानि यतो दूतस्त्वमागतः ।। 7.103.11 ।।
transliteration: tamuvāca tato rāmaḥ svāgataṃ te mahāmune | prāpayāsya ca vākyāni yato dūtastvamāgataḥ || 7.103.11 ||
translation: तम् to him, उवाच said, ततः then, रामः Rama, स्वागतम् welcome, ते to you, महामुने O great sage, प्रापय deliver, अस्य his, च and, वाक्यानि words, यतः from whom, दूतः messenger, त्वम् you, आगतः have come.
explanation: Then Rama said to him, "Welcome to you, O great sage; please deliver the messages of him from whom you have come as a messenger."

shloka_text: चोदितो राजसिंहेन मुनिर्वाक्यमभाषत । द्वन्द्वमेतत्प्रवक्तव्यं हितं वै यद्यपेक्षसे ।। 7.103.12 ।।
transliteration: codito rājasiṃhena munirvākyamabhāṣata | dvandvametatpravaktavyaṃ hitaṃ vai yadyapekṣase || 7.103.12 ||
translation: चोदितः urged, राजसिंहेन by the lion among kings, मुनिः the sage, वाक्यम् words, अभाषत spoke, द्वन्द्वम् a secret, एतत् this, प्रवक्तव्यम् to be spoken, हितम् beneficial, वै indeed, यदि if, अपेक्षसे you desire.
explanation: Urged by the lion among kings, the sage spoke these words: "This secret must be spoken if you indeed desire what is beneficial."

shloka_text: यः शृणोति निरीक्षेद्वा स वध्यो भविता तव । भवेद्वै मुनिमुख्यस्य वचनं यद्यपेक्षसे ।। 7.103.13 ।।
transliteration: yaḥ śṛṇoti nirīkṣedvā sa vadhyo bhavitā tava | bhavedvai munimukhyasya vacanaṃ yadyapekṣase || 7.103.13 ||
translation: यः whoever, शृणोति listens, निरीक्षेत् looks, वा or, सः he, वध्यः punishable by death, भविता will be, तव your, भवेत् it should be, वै indeed, मुनिमुख्यस्य of the chief of sages, वचनम् the word, यदि if, अपेक्षसे you desire.
explanation: Whoever listens or looks will be punishable by death by you, if you truly desire to heed the words of the chief of sages.

shloka_text: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् । द्वारि तिष्ठ महाबाहो प्रतिहारं विसर्जय ।। 7.103.14 ।।
transliteration: sa tatheti pratijñāya rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt | dvāri tiṣṭha mahābāho pratihāraṃ visarjaya || 7.103.14 ||
translation: सः He, तथा so, इति thus, प्रतिज्ञाय having promised, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् spoke, द्वारि at the door, तिष्ठ stand, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, प्रतिहारम् the doorkeeper, विसर्जय dismiss.
explanation: Having agreed to the condition, Rama spoke to Lakshmana, instructing him to stand at the door and dismiss the doorkeeper.

shloka_text: स मे वध्यः खलु भवेत् कथाद्वन्द्वं समीरितम् । ऋषेर्मम च सौमित्रे पश्येद्वा शृणुयाच्च यः ।। 7.103.15 ।।
transliteration: sa me vadhyaḥ khalu bhavet kathādvandvaṃ samīritam | ṛṣermama ca saumitre paśyedvā śṛṇuyācca yaḥ || 7.103.15 ||
translation: सः He, मे my, वध्यः one to be killed, खलु indeed, भवेत् would be, कथाद्वन्द्वम् the conversation of two, समीरितम् spoken, ऋषेः of the sage, मम and my, च and, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, पश्येत् sees, वा or, शृणुयात् hears, च and, यः who.
explanation: Rama declared that anyone who sees or hears the private conversation between him and the sage would indeed be worthy of death.

shloka_text: ततो निक्षिप्य काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणं द्वारि सङ्ग्रहम् । तमुवाच मुने वाक्यं कथयस्वेति राघवः ।। 7.103.16 ।।
transliteration: tato nikṣipya kākutstho lakṣmaṇaṃ dvāri saṅgraham | tamuvāca mune vākyaṃ kathayasveti rāghavaḥ || 7.103.16 ||
translation: ततः Then, निक्षिप्य having stationed, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, द्वारि at the door, सङ्ग्रहम् as a guard, तम् to him (the sage), उवाच spoke, मुने O sage, वाक्यम् the matter, कथयस्व tell, इति thus, राघवः Raghava (Rama).
explanation: Then, having stationed Lakshmana as a guard at the door, Rama (Kakutstha) spoke to the sage, saying, "O sage, please tell me the matter."

shloka_text: यत्ते मनीषितं वाक्यं येन वा ऽसि समाहितः । कथयस्वाविशङ्कस्त्वं ममापि हृदि वर्तते ।। 7.103.17 ।।
transliteration: yatte manīṣitaṃ vākyaṃ yena vā 'si samāhitaḥ | kathayasvāviśaṅkastvaṃ mamāpi hṛdi vartate || 7.103.17 ||
translation: यत् whatever, ते your, मनीषितम् desired, वाक्यम् message, येन by which, वा or, असि you are, समाहितः intent, कथयस्व tell, अविशङ्कः without hesitation, त्वम् you, मम my, अपि also, हृदि in heart, वर्तते it exists.
explanation: Rama urged the sage to speak without hesitation whatever message he desired or was intent upon, for a similar thought was also present in Rama's heart. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्र्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 103 ।। Thus ends the hundred and third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
